mission: Compile the first usable Mastermind role-method package and integrate its delivery plan with the existing harness, capability, Paper, and operator-environment owners.
why: A model subscription alone does not give a worker reliable tools, context, workspace ownership, or a useful delivery method.
user_journey: Chris asks for a capability; the correct worker receives a complete bounded brief, uses its actual approved tools, returns attributable evidence, and leaves an exact next action without manual account allocation.
machine_outcome: The existing execution and capability owners can consume a complete task prompt without a new router, installer, identity, queue, or permission service.

non_goals: No shared marketplace or validator changes.
No live provider, broker, registry, workspace, account, or worker changes.
Do not duplicate Paper PR585, operator-environment PR584, or active HF1/ACP adapter work.

inputs: Current live Chairman request and continuation.
Protected source and current source-candidate metadata, distinguished from runtime evidence.

data_contract.time: Source references are exact commits. Vendor and host observations are dated evidence, not an evergreen health claim.
data_contract.missing: Unknown runtime, workspace, auth, and provider readiness stay unknown; null bindings are authoring-only.
data_contract.corrections: Recompile when mission or method bytes change. These hashes are not canonical capability-generation or authorization receipts.
data_contract.rights: Use original playbooks, public source metadata and official documentation. Do not publish credentials, private captures, or account homes.

deterministic: Validate a closed brief shape, exact source SHA syntax, bounded input and normalized relative paths.
Compile the common method and exactly one role, with reproducible authoring hashes.
model: Synthesize the user and machine outcomes, preserve existing owner boundaries, and define useful role-specific acceptance.

deliverables: Reusable skill source with eight progressive-loading role methods.
Dependency-free compiler, complete examples and focused executable tests.
Owner-preserving master plan and exact integration handoff.
acceptance: Actual CLI input produces a complete method-enriched brief for each role.
Malformed, incomplete, oversized and misleading-structure inputs fail without executing anything.
Outputs never assert execution authority, live readiness, source authentication or acceptance.
Native Skill/tool behavior remains unproven until the existing owner completes its real-path canary.
stop_conditions: Any requested effect overlaps an incumbent source owner.
A modifying response becomes ambiguous or a required tool/policy gate is unavailable.
The next step requires actual runtime admission, provider enrollment or app authorization absent in this session.
resource_constraints: Do not launch additional model workers for this bounded authoring slice.
Use the sandbox for source authoring and focused tests; preserve active Studio workers.

continuation.record_owner: Implementation and full research in Mastermind; organizational continuity only through Macro Agent OS after resolving its existing parent.
continuation.next_action: Admit the reviewed craft package through the existing package/capability owner and consume the compiled task content through one accepted harness; do not change the four-Skill canary.
